# Selion Lab

> Independent game studio building interactive worlds on real silicon physics and simulated computer architectures.

- **Website**: https://selionlab.com
- **Contact**: contact@selionlab.com
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/yNicky092/selion-lab

## Overview

Selion Lab is an independent game studio focused on making real computer architecture and semiconductor physics playful and tactile. Every architecture created by Selion Lab runs in a custom software simulation engine designed specifically for interactive play rather than physical consumer silicon.

## Flagship Game: Silicon Emergence

- **URL**: https://selionlab.com/work/
- **Tagline**: From a single transistor to a working computer, built with real silicon physics.
- **Platforms**: Desktop and Android.
- **Description**: A 3D VLSI hardware-engineering sandbox and campaign game (72 levels across 6 chapters plus Infinite Sandbox) where every logic gate, memory cell, CPU, GPU, TPU, and NPU emerges purely from physical NMOS and PMOS transistors with no logic-gate shortcuts.
- **Core Features**:
  - 3D FinFET place-and-route with multi-layer Manhattan copper traces
  - 8-state switch-level electrical resolution, Elmore RC delays, capacitive charge sharing, and DRAM decay
  - Built-in 4-channel oscilloscope, critical-path Timing Analyzer, and 3-axis PPA Scorecard (Power, Performance, Area)
  - Glass-Box ICs with X-Ray visibility where nested transistors stay electrically live on a custom speculative wavefront simulation engine

## Simulated Computer Architectures

- **SERMM-16** (Selion Emergent RISC Micro-Machines): An original 16-bit RISC CPU architecture simulated in real time over 64 KB unified byte-addressed memory, with 8 ABI-aliased registers, a 4-bit FLAGS register, 4 uniform 16-bit instruction formats, and both host and 127-word self-hosted `serasm` assemblers.
- **SEVM & FLUX** (Selion Emergent Vector Machines): A simulated 4-lane lockstep SIMT vector GPU sharing unified 64 KB memory with SERMM-16, supporting divergence masking, warp barriers, 256-word `SMEM16` scratchpad, cross-lane shuffles, fused multiply-add, and `.flux_kernel` dispatch.
- **EmergenceOS-16 (`EOS-16.serm`)**: A simulated bare-metal 16-bit OS disk image format (`.serm`, not `.iso`) with pure assembly drivers, interactive shell, and embedded SEFS filesystem running strictly inside the SERMM-16 simulation.

## Virtual Fab

- **URL**: https://selionlab.com/work/#virtual-fab
- **Description**: A playable silicon manufacturing simulator exploring the journey from Verilog netlists through simulated photolithography, etching, doping, metallization, and packaging into real-time simulation.
